about: .XN--ZFR164B is a generic top-level domain (gTLD) delegated in the DNS root zone. The registry operator responsible for .XN--ZFR164B is listed by IANA as China Organizational Name Administration Center. Anyone can typically register a .XN--ZFR164B name through an accredited registrar, subject to the registry’s registration policy and ICANN consensus policies.
